name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Reveal related sections while keeping their headings easy to scan.

motionProfile.reason: Each disclosure panel owns one measured block size, its retained content paint and an in-place glyph indicator; trigger and item paint stay local to their own region.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Accordion integrates one opacity entrance at its retained content paint and at each later-inserted item host.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Accordion retains the closing content body while Base UI still owns the panel and fades its own paint.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: The trigger crossfades its two existing glyphs in place through the shared indicator control.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The panel owns one measured block-size transaction over its natural inner body while open and idle.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Trigger surface/foreground and item border paint transition under one focus-aware colour owner each.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Directly owned plain trigger and content strings replace only their changed graphemes.

number.roll/reels.reason: A supported direct numeric trigger or content quantity rolls only its changed places.
